title: Home is a feed of the best-rated songs; the landing page moves to /about
description: / shows scores ranked by stars (Bayesian, recent window widening when quiet) with freshness blended in; songs first, beats/chords/melodies heavily discounted. The landing page (hero, gallery) moves to /about, linked from the top bar and the feed; signed-out visitors get a short intro strip. Activity stays as the newest-first feed.
